description: Sliding glass door repair in Pompano Beach: salt on oceanfront balconies, sand in canal-home tracks, screen mesh near the water, and when a permit applies.
h1: Sliding glass door repair in Pompano Beach
subline: Oceanfront balconies, Intracoastal and canal homes, and mainland streets wear sliders out differently, so the fix starts with where your door is.
answer: Sliding glass door repair in Pompano Beach is often about salt and sand: corroded rollers, pitted tracks and clogged weep holes. Replacing a part that doesn't change the door's approval doesn't need a city permit. A new door does, and in condos the city asks for an association approval letter.
faqHeading: Pompano Beach slider questions, from the beach to the canals
closing: Send us a photo of the door, its handle and the bottom of the panel, or call, and we'll tell you what the salt has done to it.

faqs.q: Does Pompano Beach make me pull a permit just to swap the rollers?
faqs.a: No, as a rule. The city's window and door checklist says a permit isn't required to replace a part that doesn't alter the door's approval or make it unsafe. Installing a new door or doing a major repair does need a building permit.

faqs.q: Does a door replacement in Pompano Beach qualify for the under-$7,500 permit exemption?
faqs.a: No. The city's notice on House Bill 803 says installing or replacing exterior windows and doors is structural work, so it always needs a standard building permit, whatever the price.

faqs.q: What does an oceanfront condo need for a new slider permit in Pompano Beach?
faqs.a: An association approval letter is on the city's checklist, along with a product approval and a wind load chart. If the building's mean roof height is over 30 feet, the city also wants site-specific wind loads signed and sealed by a design professional.

faqs.q: Why do the rollers on my aluminum balcony door rust?
faqs.a: Because many rollers have steel bearings or axles, and they sit inside an aluminum panel. With salt water between two different metals, one corrodes. Stainless steel rollers hold up better near the ocean, if one is made in your door's size.

faqs.q: Can I replace my own condo slider in Pompano Beach as an owner-builder?
faqs.a: No. The city's window, door and shutter checklist says the owner-builder option doesn't apply to work in condominiums, so a licensed contractor has to pull the permit for a condo door replacement.
